|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T1** | `rdt-cli` 0.4.1 | `httpx` + extracted cookies + Chrome-133 header fingerprint | ✅ yes | 23 commands |
| **T2** | `rdtx` | same-origin `fetch` inside human-launched Chrome over CDP | ❌ needs Chrome | 10 commands |
| **T3** | `agent-browser` 0.32.3 | raw browser control, 75 verbs | ⚠️ | none — you write them |

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Coverage eval — EXECUTES every command in the target surface across all three
# transports and records what actually works. Not a source-reading exercise.
#
#   T1  rdt-cli   authenticated plain HTTP (httpx + cookies + Chrome-133 fingerprint)
#   T2  rdtx      same-origin fetch inside human-launched Chrome over CDP
#   T3  agent-browser  raw browser fallback, no Reddit semantics
#
# Writes are exercised only against the operator's own r/test post, and every
# subscribe is immediately reversed.

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/npm/bin:$PATH"
export RDTX_CDP_PORT="${RDTX_CDP_PORT:-9223}"

RDTX="node $HERE/rdtx.mjs"
OUT="${1:-$HERE/../.eval-results}"
mkdir -p "$OUT/raw"
